title: Single-accountable-approver Archive governance map-close evidence
closure_rule: Every required category must have covered repository evidence and at least one executable gate command or immutable artifact location before #175 can close.

categories.required_by_issue_196: Exhaustive dual-approval inventory, accepted superseding ADR, explicit cutover invariants, canonical API registration, and no remaining unclassified governance path.

scenarios.acceptance: The machine-readable inventory classifies every high-signal schema, trigger, API, capability, command, contract, test, UI, metric, runbook, ADR, fixture, and script path while the accepted ADR preserves historical four-eyes evidence.

The canonical API bundle registers accountable publication, Archive operations, and Archive workbench Path Items, resolves every required method against FastAPI, copies all referenced bounded contracts, rejects conflicts, and emits a tamper-evident integrated YAML.

categories.required_by_issue_196: Fresh and populated migration rehearsals with old/new counts, hashes, awaiting-second conversion, no auto-publish, historical audit preservation, cutover hold, and application rollback behavior.

scenarios.acceptance: Additive migrations preserve legacy records, never auto-publish revalidated work, provide deterministic GO/NO-GO snapshots, and hold or resume publication without deleting Releases or moving pointers backward.

categories.required_by_issue_196: Ordinary and sensitive publication, capability and recent-auth enforcement, stale base, optimistic conflict, idempotent replay, audit failure, transaction failure, publish_failed, and immutable Release behavior.

scenarios.acceptance: One authorized accountable editor validates and atomically publishes one immutable Release with provenance, audit, Outbox, pointer, failure metrics, conflict handling, and no implicit Administrator or service-account grant.
gate_commands: uv run --directory services/api --frozen --extra dev pytest -q tests/archive_publication tests/contracts/test_accountable_publication_storage_contract.py tests/contracts/test_accountable_publication_openapi_contract.py

categories.required_by_issue_196: Public Projection outage and retry, prior-version continuity, no duplicate Release, Activity and notification effects, and incorporation only after successful projection.

scenarios.acceptance: Archive publication remains authoritative during projection failure, the prior public version stays available, Activity projection is idempotent, and contributor or follower notifications originate from projected public-safe events without duplication.

categories.required_by_issue_196: Latest rollback, dependent targeted correction, retraction, merge/split preservation, stable aliases, Activity effects, emergency takedown, and one-business-day formal follow-up.

scenarios.acceptance: Every corrective operation creates a new immutable Release, keeps stable identity and history evidence, uses Senior capability and recent authentication where required, reduces emergency exposure only, and records follow-up obligations.
gate_commands: uv run --directory services/api --frozen --extra dev pytest -q tests/archive_operations tests/contracts/test_accountable_archive_operations_openapi_contract.py

categories.required_by_issue_196: Bounded React-admin browser and mobile journeys, keyboard and WCAG behavior, no generic CRUD, bundle isolation, noindex/no-cache, security, and approved gzip budget.

scenarios.acceptance: Archive and Senior workbenches expose complete evidence and explicit commands only, remain client-isolated from public bundles, use private no-cache/noindex responses, and are certified by browser, accessibility, and performance gates.

categories.required_by_issue_196: Observability, runbooks, database and attachment restore, feature-flag rollback, staging withdrawal and rollback, Windows and Linux Release Gate, immutable hashes, and recorded artifact locations.

scenarios.acceptance: Recovery drills, rollback switches, staging evidence, Windows/Linux gates, and sealed manifests provide reproducible final evidence without deleting accountable Archive history.
